payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for empirically evaluating the quality of data, including BLEU scores, manual inspections, and perplexity measurements.

claims.text: The quality of translations in CoVoST is evaluated using BLEU scores, comparing human translations to automatic translations, with low-scoring translations being manually inspected.
Manual inspections are conducted for translations with high perplexity and low ratios of English characters, ensuring quality control.
An evaluation set is constructed from Tatoeba, which undergoes the same quality checks as CoVoST, confirming no poor quality translations were found.
